variables.name: ORACLE_HOST
variables.description: Not localhost on purpose: the server certificate carries CN=oracle, so connecting by any other name fails with ORA-17965 unless server DN matching is switched off. Add '127.0.0.1  oracle' to your hosts file and the certificate check stays meaningful.

variables.name: ORACLE_PORT
variables.description: Plain TCP listener. Requires the ports to be published on fixed numbers - see the note at the bottom of this file.

variables.name: ORACLE_TCPS_PORT
variables.description: TLS (TCPS) listener. Also the port the tnsnames.ora inside the wallet points at.

variables.name: ORACLE_SERVICE
variables.description: Service name of the pluggable database, where the application user lives

variables.name: ORACLE_SYSTEM_USER
variables.description: The SID connection addresses the container database, where the application user (created in the PDB) does not exist

variables.name: ORACLE_SYSTEM_PASSWORD
variables.description: ORACLE_PWD of the throwaway test container

variables.name: ORACLE_WALLET_DIR
variables.description: Where you copied the wallet to on this machine: docker cp integration-tests-oracle-1:/opt/oracle/oradata/clientWallet/FREE /tmp/oracle-wallet . Re-copy it if you ever recreate the container with 'down -v': a new container issues a new server certificate, and a wallet from the old one fails with 'signature check failed'.

variables.name: ORACLE_LOCAL_SETUP
variables.description: Three steps before this environment works. 1) Start the database with the ports on fixed numbers, because the integration test compose publishes random ones: create an override file containing 'services: {oracle: {ports: ["1521:1521", "2484:2484"]}}' and run 'docker compose -f docker/integration-tests/integration-tests-oracle.yaml -f <override> up -d oracle'. 2) Once it reports healthy, copy the wallet out with the docker cp command in ORACLE_WALLET_DIR above. 3) Add '127.0.0.1  oracle' to your hosts file, see ORACLE_HOST. Then install the driver with 'hop driver install oracle --accept-license'.
